1. Draw a sketch: line, rectangle, circle … Lines end at points; closed outlines become profiles.
2. Dimension: tap a line for its length, a circle for its diameter, two elements for distance or angle. Tap a dimension to change it.
3. Tap “Done”, then Body › Extrude (or Revolve). After that add holes, fillets, patterns, shells …
Every step stays editable: tap it in the timeline below to select it, tap again to edit it, long-press for Rename and Delete. The model rebuilds; parameters turn dimensions into formulas.
The start page shows quick start and your recent projects. To get back there, use the Back button or Project menu › Start page. Changes are saved automatically.
Tap to select, tap again to deselect; to select several elements, tap them one after another. Tapping empty space clears the selection and closes open bars.
A drawing tool ends after one finished shape, when you tap its button again, or with ✕. Two fingers: pan and zoom.
Pen eraser: deletes whatever it touches. Mouse: wheel zooms, middle button pans, right button cancels.
Keyboard: L line, R rectangle, C circle, A arc, S end tool · Del deletes · Esc cancels · Ctrl+Z/Y undo/redo · Ctrl+A select all.
Drag to rotate; two fingers or the mouse wheel zoom. “View” switches to Top/Front/Right and fits the model.
Tap edges and faces when a tool asks for them (Fillet, Hole, Shell, Measure). ↶ ↷ undo and redo changes.
